reconfigure.title: Change the service URL
reconfigure.description: Enter the new base URL of the running service, reachable from Home Assistant. The connection is checked before saving. Your existing entities are preserved.

user.title: Connect to Lightinator Log Service
user.description: Start the service before continuing. For the Home Assistant add-on, enter http://<home-assistant-host>:4821. For an external container, enter http://<container-host>:4821, or its service name if Home Assistant shares its Docker network. Use an address reachable from Home Assistant. The integration connects to the service; it does not start the container. The URL must return status ok at /api/v1/health.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without a path.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the service URL.
error.invalid_response: The URL did not return a valid Lightinator Log Service response.

abort.already_configured: This service URL is already configured.
